name: ColocBoost
model_likelihood: Joint trait-specific multiple linear regressions with fixed effects on standardized traits and genotypes.
prior: No explicit trait-sharing prior; cross-trait gradient norm and entropy/KL-regularized LD proximity smoothing.
inference_algorithm: Sequential PSGB updates with local SEC coupling decisions based on profile log-likelihood comparisons.
estimand: Event triplets (locus, trait-sharing configuration, nominal CoS_alpha) and variant colocalization probabilities.
data_input: Individual-level genotypes and traits or association summary statistics with external LD; mixed inputs across traits.
tunable_settings: CoS coverage alpha (default 0.95); temperature tau > 0 (default 0.01); LD-reference mixing lambda (default 0.5); logarithmic-pooling concentration nu (default 1.5); coupling equivalence and CoS filtering thresholds.

name: FineBoost
model_likelihood: Single-trait restriction of the fixed-effect linear regression model.
prior: Single-trait gradient objective with entropy/KL-regularized LD proximity smoothing.
inference_algorithm: Single-trait PSGB, the L = 1 restriction of ColocBoost.
data_input: Single-trait genotype/phenotype or summary-statistic inputs under the shared framework.
tunable_settings: L = 1 defines the restriction; shared proximity-smoothing temperature and LD-reference mixing settings.
